originalTitle: UltraTech Cement comes up with a record June quarter, profit surges 17%
simplifiedContent: UltraTech Cement had a very good quarter from April to June, with its highest-ever sales and profit. The company's sales went up by 16% and its profit increased by 17%, which is a big jump. This happened even though the costs of making cement went up a lot due to the war, which is a big challenge. Despite these higher costs, the company was still able to make more money, which shows it can handle price increases well. This is a positive sign for the company and its investors, as it was able to grow its sales and profit more than expected.

originalTitle: CSB Bank Q1 profit jumps 27% YoY to Rs 150 crore as provisions decline
simplifiedContent: CSB Bank just announced that it made a profit of Rs 150 crore in the first quarter of the year, which is 27% more than it made during the same time last year. This increase is largely due to the bank having to set aside less money for potential losses, and also because it earned more from interest on loans. The bank's loan business, especially gold loans, is doing well and is growing. Although the bank's profit is down from the previous quarter, this is a normal trend for the first quarter. Overall, the bank is doing well and is focusing on getting more customers and growing its retail business.

originalTitle: PRISM's premium hotel push emerges as next leg of India growth ahead of IPO
simplifiedContent: PRISM, a company that will soon be selling stocks to the public, is focusing on high-end hotels in India. They have been growing their network of company-managed hotels, which has become a big part of their business. In fact, these hotels made up almost half of the total value of bookings in India over the last nine months. This change in focus is part of a larger trend in India's hotel market, where many different companies are competing. By emphasizing quality and efficiency, PRISM is shifting its strategy from just expanding its network to prioritizing better services and results.

originalTitle: Two-year yields hit 17-month high on oil surge, Fed fears
simplifiedContent: The interest rate on a type of US government bond, called a 2-year Treasury, has reached its highest level in 17 months. This happened because the price of oil has increased and there are concerns about what the Federal Reserve (the US central bank) might do next. As a result, investors are selling these bonds, which causes the interest rate to rise. This is significant because it can affect the overall economy and other investments. The increase in interest rates may be a sign that investors are expecting the Federal Reserve to take action, which could have further impacts on the market.

originalTitle: Gold firms to two-week peak on softer dollar, Fed outlook in focus
simplifiedContent: The price of gold has gone up to its highest point in two weeks. This happened because the value of the US dollar has gone down, making gold more attractive to buy. Investors are also waiting to see what the Federal Reserve (also known as the "Fed") will do next, which is affecting the price of gold. The increase in gold's price is important because it shows that investors are interested in buying gold, possibly because they think the dollar might keep losing value. The Fed's upcoming decisions may continue to impact the price of gold.

originalTitle: Lohia Corp raises  ₹492 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO opening on Thursday
simplifiedContent: Lohia Corp, a company that's about to go public, has already raised a significant amount of money - ₹492.1 crore - from big investors before its initial public offering (IPO) even starts. The IPO is set to begin on July 23, 2026, and the company has decided on a price range of ₹404 to ₹425 per share. This means that the company has given over 1.15 million shares to these big investors at a price within this range. This matters because it shows that big investors are interested in the company, which could be a positive sign for other investors. The company's IPO will give regular investors a chance to buy shares in the company starting on Thursday.
